ctx.x: Did you feel any special musical kinship with Lester Young? You said that Lester liked your beat and that you always found eachother at jam sessions. What was your musical relationship?

Well, naturally we had a musical rapport. We just dug eachother. And when he would come to Chicago with Basie he would always find me, I'd find him, we'd find eachother, and we would play together every night. We used to go around to clubs and find places to play. One place we used to go to in particular was on 51st Street, and why I mention this is Israel Crosby's sister, siste worked in this club. One played drums and one played piano. And we would
go over and just take over the job and jam all night long, you know.
